entries.title: Your first mate checks before it answers a question of fact
entries.body: When you ask your first mate something factual, such as whether a fix has reached a release, it now looks it up first or has a crewmate read it. When it has not checked, it says so plainly instead of answering as if it knew.
entries.noPicture: The change is in what the first mate says, not in how any screen looks.
